_readme: CAR PARK CONFIG — BBC Radio 2 in the Park, Stirling 2026 journey planner. To change availability: edit the 'status' line of a car park, then commit. Netlify redeploys in ~60 seconds. Valid status values: 'onsale' (bookable, shown normally), 'soldout' (shown greyed with a Sold Out badge, not routed to), 'hidden' (not shown at all). Do not change 'zone' or 'junction' unless the TTP changes. 'days' restricts availability: 'all' or 'satsun'. Prices are per TTP v4.0 (flat £15). See CARPARK-EDIT-GUIDE.md in this repo for step-by-step instructions.
